 India last played Bhutan in an official match 14 years ago though their previous encounter was an unofficial friendly in 2025.
 | Photo Credit: AIFF Media
 India last played Bhutan in an official match 14 years ago though their previous encounter was an unofficial friendly in 2025.
 | Photo Credit: AIFF Media
 India will look to continue its title defence at the SAFF Championship 2026 when it takes on Bhutan in the semifinals at the National Stadium here in Bangladesh on Saturday.
 Naushad Moosa’s side beat Pakistan 3-2 before pipping the Maldives 1-0 to secure a spot in the final four. Bhutan, on the other hand, drew 2-2 with Sri Lanka, and the lone point was enough to help it finish second in its group and enter the semis.
 India and Bhutan last played in an unofficial friendly in 2025, which the Blue Tigers won 6-1, with goals from Vikram Pratap Singh (2), Rahim Ali, Ryan Williams, Bikash, and Irfan Yawad.
 Overall, India enjoys a dominating 7-0 head-to-head record over Bhutan, including the latest unofficial game.
 India vs Bhutan Head-to-Head:
 India 6-1 Bhutan (November 13, 2025) – Unofficial 
 Bhutan 0 – 3 India (August 13, 2016) – Unofficial 
 India 5 – 0 Bhutan (December 5, 2011) 
 India 2 – 1 Bhutan (June 11, 2008) 
 India 3 – 0 Bhutan (December 10, 2005) 
 India 0-3 Bhutan (September 28, 1999) 
 Bhutan 0-3 India (December 23, 1985)
